title: GitHub issue-comment exact response parity governed migration readiness

phases.objective: Provide one exact-token, Production-bound, checksum-bound readiness bridge for the GitHub issue-comment exact-response parity migration that records governed authorization and performs dry-run only, while keeping Migration Apply, provider calls, external writes, credential payload access, and protected-ref mutation outside this PR.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Issue 4451 exact migration authorization comment on the trusted default-branch workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow proves source migration identity and exact Production/runtime parity, creates a short-lived capability envelope, records checksum-bound authorization, and completes governed_migration_execute in dry_run mode with applies_sql=false without Migration Apply or provider execution.
steps: Require issue 4451, the exact authorization token, and OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR author association.
Require source PR 6814 merge identity, migration Git blob SHA, raw-byte SHA-256 checksum, and executable statement count to remain pinned.
Require protected Production and public runtime readbacks to equal 25ca4dbff6bb6bef18b0da24a349348e66200639 before authorization mutation.
Re-read protected Production after runtime parity and fail closed if the ref moved.
Create or approve a short-lived capability resolution envelope scoped to governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap and the exact migration resource binding.
Call governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap using the exact filename, checksum, statement count, source PR, source merge SHA, typed confirmation, and envelope ID.
Invoke governed_migration_execute only in dry_run mode and require applies_sql=false with exact checksum and statement count.
Upload sanitized evidence recording Migration Apply, provider call, external write, credential payload access, protected-ref mutation, and force push as false.
assertions: The workflow exposes no Apply trigger, phase, or job.
The wrapper contains no governed_migration_execute call with mode apply and no Apply confirmation token.
Production drift, runtime drift, source identity drift, migration checksum drift, statement-count drift, authorization failure, or dry-run contract failure fails closed.
The bridge never dispatches github_create_issue_comment and performs no provider call or protected-ref mutation.
